note: Derived from undercity-spec.md §8 (Round Configuration). Round lengths, inject counts and mechanics are transcribed from that table. Per-beat runbook rows are intentionally EMPTY — inject timings and artifact instructions ('hand F-201 card to POW') exist in no build input, and are authored from the facilitation design. The control panel renders whatever beats this file contains; the off-script inject library works regardless. Phases (spec: SETUP→FINISHED) map onto these rounds and a mode; see phases[]. Balance numbers live in config/scenarios/*.json, which override these defaults.

rounds.name: Stable Ops
rounds.purpose: Baseline capture — must feel comfortably manageable

rounds.name: Interdependence
rounds.injects: Cross-sector cascades x4-5; 1 false alarm; discrepancy live

rounds.name: Core Failure
rounds.injects: Critical stack x3; Core drops to 60% at 05:00; Continuity Order due 25:00
rounds.purpose: Peak stress; values conflict; decision under deadline

rounds.name: Aftershock
rounds.purpose: Post-measurement — the delta is the product

phases.name: Setup
phases.hint: Laptops connected, binders on tables, klaxon not yet fired.

phases.name: Orientation
phases.hint: Tutorial fault per sector. Zero stakes.

phases.name: Debrief 1
phases.hint: Headline metrics; one written commitment each.

phases.name: Aftershock
phases.hint: Same systems, fresh crisis. The delta is the product.

phases.name: Debrief 2
phases.hint: Round 3 vs Aftershock on the wall.

phases.name: Finished
phases.hint: Export the log. Reset before the next cohort.
